name: wmww-agent-skills
description: Tess's personal skills for coding agents

plugins.name: claudewait
plugins.description: Wait for background Bash tasks to finish with `claudewait ID...`, instead of writing until/sleep polling loops.

plugins.name: gui-testing
plugins.description: Run a Linux GUI program in a disposable headless Wayland session, take screenshots and inject mouse/keyboard events. Use to test rendering/interaction/etc of a Wayland/X11 app.

plugins.name: reasonable-rust-builds
plugins.description: Keep Rust/cargo builds fast and target dirs from eating tens of GBs (debuginfo, test binaries, artifact sets, worktrees), with `wt` for warm task worktrees whose targets prune to what is in use. Use when starting a Rust project, reorganizing a Rust repo's build/test/worktree workflow, or when builds are slow or target/ disk use is a problem.

plugins.name: timegap
plugins.description: Timestamp a program's output and measure the gaps between lines with `tg` (timegap). Use to find which step of a slow command eats the time, spot stalls in live logs, and debug timing-dependent behaviour.

plugins.name: web-explainer
plugins.description: Guidance for building clear, delightful web pages, especially explainers, tutorials and documentation — compact prose, purposeful design, and plain HTML/CSS/JS. Use when writing or designing a web-based explainer or docs site.
